# African Drum - Guinean

\\n

## Lenge Wood. 13" / 330mm.

\\nThe Guinean African Drum is the best money can buy. The top quality wood is increasingly rare and highly sort after. Especially by professional players who love the beautiful melodic tone. The Guinean carvers have perfected the internal dimensions and use a special spiral carving technique which further enhances the clarity and projection of the sound of the drum. The Guinean Djembe Drum will endure life times of playing with a quality that has the ability to evolve and grow with the player. **\\n**
